title: SMA(200) Trend Filter Performance
hypothesis: Adding a SMA(200) trend filter (only take long signals when price > SMA(200)) will improve risk-adjusted returns by keeping the strategy out of bear markets.
results_summary: Strategy C underperforms baseline across all 8 pairs. Average return dropped from +7.8% to +1.3% (-83%). Sharpe fell from 0.20 to 0.10. Drawdown improved only marginally (14.7% → 8.8%). The filter was too restrictive in a bull market.
conclusion: The SMA(200) trend filter is harmful in the current bull-market regime. Returns reduced far more than risk.
next_step: Test volatility-based filter (ATR or Bollinger Bands) or MACD confirmation.
